description:
Canonical vectors for the callsign-blocklist gate, shared between MCProxy's MessageRouter.blocklist_decision (src/mcapp/main.py) and the webapp's mirror of it in processDataElement (src/services/messageProcessor.ts). Both sides classify an inbound payload from a blocked src as pass/redirect/drop using the same rules: strip the via-relay path off src before matching (first comma component), resolve dst to its effective target (last comma component of a via-routed 'VIA,TARGET'), and treat numeric groups plus '*'/'ALL'/'TEST' as group-like (redirect to the spam group) while everything else drops. `blocklist` entries are matched by EXACT string (no SSID normalization) against src, both sides upper-cased before comparison.

Each vector's `decision` is MCProxy's actual output (verified live against MessageRouter.blocklist_decision — see MCProxy/src/mcapp/send_path_tests.py). This file is vendored byte-for-byte (parsed-equal, not literal-byte-equal — Prettier reformats the webapp copy) at webapp/src/services/__tests__/blocklist_decision_vectors.json; a spec there diffs the two copies when both repos are checked out side by side.

RESOLVED DIVERGENCE (2026-07-27 drift-resolution campaign, webapp docs/code-simpl-v2.md): earlier versions of this file documented that the webapp's isGroupDst was a bare /^\d+$/ test while MCProxy's is_group() enforced 1..99999, so an out-of-range numeric dst ('0', '100000') from a blocked src redirected on the webapp but dropped on MCProxy. The group predicate is now unified across all three repos (see group_dst_vectors.json, canonical at MCProxy/src/mcapp/commands/group_dst_vectors.json) and BOTH sides drop: the former divergence vectors below carry a single `decision` like every other vector, and the per-side `webapp_decision`/`note` escape hatch is gone from this file. v2: hashtag destinations are group-like for quarantine purposes -- blocked-sender traffic to a '#TAG' is redirected to SPAM_GROUP and stays inspectable, matching numeric-group behaviour, instead of being dropped outright. A malformed '#' destination is still dropped.

vectors.name: unblocked src passes through
blocked src + numeric group dst redirects to the spam group
blocked src + personal dst drops (not redirected)
blocked src + broadcast dst '*' redirects
blocked src + broadcast dst 'ALL' redirects
blocked src + special group dst 'TEST' redirects
via-routed blocked src (sender is the first hop) + group dst redirects
via-routed blocked src + personal dst drops
via-routed group dst resolves from the LAST comma component
a blocked RELAY hop (not the sender) must NOT trigger the gate
SSID-specific block does not cover a different SSID of the same base call
base-callsign block does not cover any SSID'd variant (exact match only, no normalization)
lower-case incoming src is still matched (both sides upper-case before comparing)
empty blocklist passes everything
numeric group dst at the upper boundary (99999) is still in-range on both sides
out-of-range numeric dst '0' is not a group: blocked src drops (unified 2026-07-27, group_dst_vectors.json)
out-of-range numeric dst '100000' is not a group: blocked src drops (unified 2026-07-27, group_dst_vectors.json)
blocked src to a hashtag is quarantined, not dropped
blocked src to a via-routed hashtag is quarantined
blocked src to a MALFORMED hashtag is dropped (addresses nobody)
unblocked src to a hashtag passes through
